pages.text: Gold ingots at the corners, a redstone block at the top, iron bars at the other edges, and a furnace in the center.

pages.title: Instant Smelting
pages.text: The Smelter applies a furnace smelting recipe as an item enters, then pushes the result to its output in the same tick.$(br2)Each smelted input item costs $(thing)1,000 RF$(). Items without a furnace recipe pass through unchanged and use no RF.

pages.title: Item Connections
pages.text: The furnace face is the input and faces you when placed. The opposite blast-furnace face is the output.$(br2)Finish an incoming belt on the input face. Click the output face to start an outgoing belt.$(br2)Smeltable inputs wait upstream while power or output space is unavailable.

pages.title: Power
pages.text: Connect Forge Energy cables or generators to any of the four copper faces, including the top and bottom.$(br2)The internal buffer holds $(thing)10,000 RF$(). It can receive all missing energy in one tick, subject to the supply available from your power source.
